bryce.l: hey everyone, day 2 here. i need Vault access and a KMS-wrapped secret to share with an external vendor for a demo. who do i ping and what's the minimum info they need?

carmen.p: welcome! :wave: short flow: 1) request via @secrets-bot with env/resource/reason/duration_hours (add wrap_key and target_account for cross-account sharing), 2) infra queues it, 3) cloud-security reviews wraps, 4) you'll get an ephemeral vault token or wrapped ciphertext. prod requests are stricter.

olivia.h: ops tip: you'll authenticate to Vault via SSO (OIDC). after infra grants access run `vault login -method=oidc role=redwood-dev` then `vault kv get -field=value secret/team/redwood-inference/<name>`. For wrapped ciphertext we usually attach a file to the ticket; to decrypt locally use the cloud KMS CLI for your cloud provider.

bryce.l: can you paste a bot request template i can copy/paste?

secrets-bot: Template: `@secrets-bot request env=staging resource=secret/data/team/<team>/demo reason="<short reason>" duration_hours=4 wrap_key=projects/<proj>/locations/global/keyRings/<ring>/cryptoKeys/<key> target_account=acct-XXXXX sensitive=true` Note: add `rotation=auto|manual` to choose a rotation policy.

carmen.p: rotation notes: default user sessions = 8h, service keys = monthly auto-rotate. If you select `rotation=auto` we attach a monthly rotation policy and email the owners before rotation. For long-lived service credentials ask for a service-role instead of a user token.

bryce.l: who can approve production secrets? wondering what the checklist looks like.

security-bot: Production secrets require two approvers: at least one eng-security reviewer and one product/infra owner for the owning service. We also require a revocation runbook and justification explaining why it can't be scoped to a service role. Cross-account wraps add cloud-security reviewers. All prod approvals are audited.

olivia.h: extra practicals: 1) never commit plaintext or decrypted files to git, 2) include the SEC ticket id in any PR that references the secret (we automatically scan PRs), 3) for CI use ephemeral tokens injected into the pipeline secret store.

bryce.l: thanks, submitting now. `@secrets-bot request env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/vendor-demo reason="vendor integration demo" duration_hours=3 wrap_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/demo/cryptoKeys/demoKey target_account=acct-99999 rotation=auto sensitive=true`

secrets-bot: Request received. Ticket SEC-6001 created. Expect ~30-45m for cross-account review. If urgent, ping @carmen.p with SEC-6001.

bryce.l: awesome — appreciate the quick help. i'll add SEC-6001 to the demo PR and follow up if anything blocks.

carmen.p: welcome aboard! DM me if you want a 10-15min walkthrough of the Vault/KMS flow.
